# Freemy AI

Freemy AI is a local-first personal AI project focused on persistent memory,
model choice, owner-controlled agent permissions, and portability.

Official website:
https://freemy.ai

GitHub:
https://github.com/freemyai

Key principle:
The AI you own.

Product status:
Pre-alpha / building in public.

Core concepts:
- persistent personal AI memory
- local-first inference
- bring your own model
- personal AI agents
- owner-controlled permissions
- portable identity
